text:
jamal: quick alert — SCIM failures for tenant=acmecorp after the RBAC rename deploy at 08:58. decrypt errors in provisioner.

alex: sample error?

jamal: log snippet: ```2026-03-23T09:11:02Z ERROR provisioner.scim decrypt failed key=projects/redwood-kms/keys/identity tenant=acmecorp err=DecryptionFailure: encryption context mismatch (expected: role=engineer-old, got: role=engineer-new) object_id=usr-987 trace=tx-1a2b```

mira: that matches context-bound KMS usage. role mapping changed, so ciphertexts encrypted under old context can't be decrypted with new one.

petra: mitigation: fallback decrypt with previous context(s) + rewrap job. Must emit audit events.

alex: I'll ship a small patch to try contexts [new, old] behind a tenant-scoped feature flag and log fallback use.

ops-bot: deploy request queued: patch/provisioner/fallback-decrypt -> staging.

idp-proxy-bot: mapping snapshot for tenant=acmecorp: {previous: "engineer-old", current: "engineer-new", changed_at: "2026-03-23T08:58:12Z"}

alex: staging deploy succeeded. enabling flag for acmecorp: `/admin/flags set provisioner.fallback_decrypt.acmecorp=true`

jamal: staging logs show ~10 fallbacks, logged old_context. good.

sre-oncall: watch KMS QPS. double decrypt attempts will raise traffic. lowered KMS alert to 1500 req/min.

petra: planning rewrap dry-run: 50 objects across 3 tenants, write audit events to audit-log-stream/rewrap, verify provisioning after rewrap. target EOD.

mira: support notified AcmeCorp CSM. they want a postmortem.

jamal: actions: alex -> PR and tenant-scoped flag, petra -> rewrap plan + audit events, mira -> support comms, sre-oncall -> temporary KMS alert tuning. reconvene after dry-run. :thumbsup:
